description.p: NoteMe is a simple note-taking application for GNOME. Write rich text notes, organize them with pins and color labels, and find them quickly with search. Notes are saved automatically as you type.

ul.li: Rich text formatting: bold, italic, underline, inline code and bullet lists
Markdown headings and blockquotes, with a live side-by-side preview
Pin notes to the top and label them with colors
Insert images by file chooser or drag and drop
Encrypt individual notes with a password (AES-256)
Back up and restore all notes and images
Export notes to Markdown or plain text
Optional extensions: word count, note information and more
